transcript.text: Good morning, everyone. We have a time-sensitive matter to address. As you're all aware, a former senior engineer left last week for a direct competitor, and we have reason to believe proprietary engineering materials may have been copied before their departure. I'm prepared to consider approving an emergency court application, but under our pre-motion review routine, I need to receive separate on-the-record reports from each of our specialists — litigation, forensic discovery, client-relations, and insurance counsel — before I can approve anything. Each of you will report your material findings individually, and I'll record each report under your name. Let's begin. Who would like to go first?
